Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.games.tictactoe

Class TicTacToeModel

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.games.tictactoe.TicTacToeModel
public class TicTacToeModel extends Object
Pure tic-tac-toe rules and an unbeatable minimax opponent, kept free of any lg3d / AWT dependency so it can be exercised headlessly.

The board is nine cells, EMPTY / HUMAN / AI. The human always plays HUMAN; who moves first alternates with reset(boolean). bestMove() returns the AI's optimal cell (full-width minimax on a 3x3 board is trivial), so perfect play from the human can only ever draw.

    • aiMove

      public void aiMove()
      Lets the AI take its turn (no-op unless it is already the AI's move and the game is live). Uses full-width minimax, so the reply is optimal.

    • bestMove

      public int bestMove()
      Returns the AI's optimal cell for the current position, or -1 when the game is already over. Prefers an immediate win, then a block, then the centre, then a corner, then a side — all of which minimax confirms.
